import json, os, tempfile, time, contextlib, sys
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch

repo=Path("/Users/steventran/do-again")
sys.path.insert(0,str(repo/"src"))
from do_again.service import liveness

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    root=Path(td)
    test_repo=root/"repo"; test_repo.mkdir()
    state=root/"state"; state.mkdir()
    control=root/"control"; control.mkdir()
    receipts=control/"automation/do_again/receipts"; receipts.mkdir(parents=True)

    receipt=receipts/"r1.json"
    receipt.write_text('{"request_id":"r1"}',encoding="utf-8")
    old=time.time()-3600
    os.utime(receipt,(old,old))
    (test_repo/"do-again.toml").write_text(
        "[do_again]\ncontinuous = true\nidle_seconds = 60\nrecovery_seconds = 60\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    target=Mock()
    with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
        stack.enter_context(patch.object(liveness.browser,"ensure_browser_running",return_value={"port":9223}))
        stack.enter_context(patch.object(liveness.browser,"project_record",return_value={"chat_url":"https://chatgpt.com/c/project"}))
        stack.enter_context(patch.object(liveness.browser,"_find_chatgpt_target",return_value=target))
        stack.enter_context(patch.object(liveness.browser,"_assistant_snapshot",return_value={"busy":False}))
        stack.enter_context(patch.object(liveness.browser,"_context_limit_warning",return_value=""))
        stack.enter_context(patch.object(liveness.browser,"_page_contains",return_value=False))
        send=stack.enter_context(patch.object(liveness.browser,"send_message"))
        send.side_effect=TimeoutError("injected network/CDP outcome unknown")

        first_exc=None
        try:
            liveness.check_liveness(test_repo,control,state)
        except Exception as exc:
            first_exc=type(exc).__name__+":"+str(exc)

        row1=json.loads((state/"liveness.json").read_text())
        calls_after_first=send.call_count

        send.side_effect=None
        second=liveness.check_liveness(test_repo,control,state)
        row2=json.loads((state/"liveness.json").read_text())
        calls_after_second=send.call_count

        row2["idle_resume_at"]=time.time()-120
        (state/"liveness.json").write_text(json.dumps(row2),encoding="utf-8")
        third=liveness.check_liveness(test_repo,control,state)
        row3=json.loads((state/"liveness.json").read_text())
        calls_after_third=send.call_count

    out={
      "first_exception":first_exc,
      "first":row1,
      "second_state":second,
      "second":row2,
      "third_state":third,
      "third":row3,
      "send_calls":[calls_after_first,calls_after_second,calls_after_third],
    }
    print(json.dumps(out,indent=2,sort_keys=True))

    if not first_exc or not first_exc.startswith("TimeoutError:"):
        raise SystemExit("injected transport failure was not surfaced")
    if row1.get("idle_resume_phase")!="uncertain":
        raise SystemExit(f"transport outcome not persisted uncertain: {row1}")
    if int(row1.get("attempts",0))!=1:
        raise SystemExit(f"unexpected recovery attempts after fault: {row1}")
    if second!="idle_delivery_uncertain":
        raise SystemExit(f"uncertain delivery not held fail-closed: {second}")
    if calls_after_second!=1:
        raise SystemExit(f"duplicate resend occurred on second tick: {calls_after_second}")
    if third!="stalled_idle_handoff":
        raise SystemExit(f"bounded escalation missing: {third}")
    if calls_after_third!=1:
        raise SystemExit(f"duplicate resend occurred at escalation: {calls_after_third}")
    if "No receipt arrived" not in str(row3.get("idle_resume_error","")):
        raise SystemExit(f"missing actionable stall reason: {row3}")

print("TRANSPORT_FAILURE_NO_REPLAY_ACCEPTANCE_OK")
